title: Realistify
body: # Realistify — Full Edition ![RealistifyTITLE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ed1f0e980389310f5639633d774b42c6273feb4.png) > *Minecraft is no longer a game. It's a world.* --- ## ✨ Overview **Realistify Full Edition** is the complete version of the Realistify project — a hyper-realistic Fabric modpack for Minecraft 1.21.1 that rebuilds every sensory layer of the game from the ground up. This is not about shaders. Shaders are just the surface. Every footstep echoes differently on wood, gravel, mud, or stone. Sound reverberates inside caves and is muffled through walls. Rain has physical weight — individual droplets splash on surfaces and accumulate. Forests breathe with ambient audio. Winter comes. Snow builds up. Animals have behaviors. Bears exist. The world is not a backdrop. It's alive. **Realistify Full Edition** is designed for high-end PCs (8 GB RAM minimum). For mid-range hardware, use [RealistifyLITE](https://modrinth.com/modpack/realistifylite). This pack focuses on: - Full acoustic realism — footsteps, reverb, biome ambiance - Complete visual overhaul — LOD terrain, particle physics, dynamic lighting - World depth — realistic terrain via Terralith, living seasons via Serene Seasons - Ecological realism — animal behaviors, expanded food systems, spawn animations - Zero performance compromise — full Fabric optimization stack underneath everything --- ## 🔥 What Makes This Different From Realistify Lite | | Realistify Lite | Realistify Full | |---|---|---| | Target hardware | Mid-range (4–8 GB) | High-end (8 GB+) | | Sound | Vanilla | Footsteps + reverb + biome audio | | Terrain | Vanilla | Terralith — 85+ biomes, realistic cliffs | | Seasons | None | Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter | | Animals | Vanilla | Naturalist — realistic animal behaviors | | LOD rendering | None | Distant Horizons — see for 128+ chunks | | Rain | Vanilla | Particle Rain — physics-accurate droplets | | Food | Vanilla | Farmer's Delight — full cooking system | | Mod count | ~47 | ~70 | --- ## 🎧 Sound Realism *The most immersive audio experience in any Vanilla+ modpack.* - **Presence Footsteps** — Every block surface has a unique footstep sound. Walk on grass, stone, sand, gravel, wood, mud — they all sound different. Mobs have matching sounds too. - **AmbientSounds 6** — Each biome has layered ambient audio. Forests rustle. Deserts hum with heat. Caves drip. Ocean waves crash. The sound changes as you move through the world. - **Sound Physics Remastered** — Acoustic reverb and echo. Shout in a cave — it echoes. Be underground and hear the muffled sounds of rain above. Sound behaves like real physics. > **Note:** Sound Physics Remastered has significant CPU overhead. On lower high-end systems (6–8 GB RAM, older CPU), you can disable it in Mod Menu without affecting the rest of the pack. --- ## 🌍 World Realism *A Minecraft world that looks like it was geologically formed.* - **Terralith** — Completely rebuilds vanilla terrain with 85+ new biomes: alpine meadows, volcanic craters, coastal cliffs, river deltas, and more. Works seamlessly with all vanilla structures. - **Serene Seasons** — Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter. Trees change color in autumn. Snow accumulates in winter. Crops grow and die by season. The world changes around you over time. - **Wilder Wild** — Enhanced vanilla biomes with new particles, sounds, fireflies at night, and ancient city atmosphere. > **Multiplayer note:** Terralith and Serene Seasons require server-side installation for their features to work on multiplayer servers. On vanilla servers, these mods are silently ignored and the pack runs normally. --- ## 🐻 Ecology & Nature *Animals that act like animals.* - **Alex's Mobs** — Adds realistic animal behaviors. Penguins in winter (with Serene Seasons). And many more animals! - **Spawn Animations** — Mobs no longer pop into existence. They emerge from the ground, materialize from the environment, rise from the darkness. Hostile spawning feels organic and terrifying. --- ## 🌄 Visual Realism *Distant Horizons means you can see for kilometers. Real kilometers.* - **Distant Horizons** — LOD rendering renders terrain 128+ chunks in every direction as detailed geometry. Mountains exist on the horizon. The world feels genuinely vast for the first time. - **Iris Shaders** — Full shader pipeline. Complementary Reimagined recommended for this pack. - **Particle Rain** — Individual rain droplets with physics. They splash on blocks, accumulate on surfaces, interact with the world differently on grass vs stone vs water. - **Continuity** — Connected glass, bookshelf textures, and more. - **LambDynamicLights** — Held torches cast real light on the world. - **Wakes** — Water surface disturbs realistically as players, boats, and mobs move through it. - **Visuality** — Extra micro-effects: spark particles, firefly glow, landing dust, water splashes. - **EMF + ETF** — Custom 3D entity models and random/emissive textures. --- ## ⚡ Performance Realistify Full is built on the complete current Fabric performance meta. The immersion stack runs *on top* of a fully optimized engine — not instead of one. Performance mods included: Sodium, Sodium Extra, Lithium, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, Entity Culling, More Culling, ModernFix, Memory Leak Fix, Dynamic FPS, Krypton, FastQuit, BadOptimizations, C2ME, Noisium, ScalableLux, Exordium Optional: Nvidium *(NVIDIA only)*, ThreadTweak, VMP *(multiplayer)* --- ## 🎨 Shader Recommendations | Setup | Shader | |-------|--------| | Recommended | Complementary Reimagined | | Cinema quality | SuperDuperVanilla | Shaders included. --- ## 🧩 Included Mods ### Performance (17 core + 1 optional) Sodium, Sodium Extra, Lithium, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, Entity Culling, More Culling, ModernFix, Memory Leak Fix, Dynamic FPS, Krypton, FastQuit, BadOptimizations, C2ME, Noisium, ScalableLux, Exordium, *ThreadTweak (opt)*. ### Visual Realism (14 mods) Iris Shaders, Continuity, LambDynamicLights, LambdaBetterGrass, Falling Leaves, EMF, ETF, 3D Skin Layers, FabricSkyboxes, OptiGUI, Distant Horizons, Particle Rain, Visuality, Wakes, Cull Less Leaves ### Sound Realism (3 mods) Presence Footsteps, AmbientSounds 5, Sound Physics Remastered ### World Realism (3 mods) Terralith, Serene Seasons, Wilder Wild ### Ecology & Nature (2 mods) Alex's Mobs, Spawn Animations ### Quality of Life (16 mods) Jade, AppleSkin, Xaero's Minimap, Xaero's World Map, Inventory Profiles Next, BetterF3, Mouse Tweaks, ShulkerBoxTooltip, Mod Menu, Reese's Sodium Options, No Chat Reports, Better Statistics Screen, Enchantment Descriptions, Zoomify, JEI, Camera Utils. ### Optional (6 mods) Capes, Better Ping Display, Resourcify, Nvidium, ThreadTweak ### Libraries (5) Fabric API, Cloth Config, YetAnotherConfigLib, Architectury API, Patchouli --- ## 💻 System Requirements **Minimum (reduced settings, no Distant Horizons):** - RAM: 6 GB allocated - CPU: Modern quad-core - GPU: Dedicated GPU — GTX 970 / RX 480 minimum - Java: 21 (Adoptium) **Recommended (full experience with shaders):** - RAM: 8 GB allocated - CPU: Modern 6-core or better - GPU: GTX 1070 / RX 5700 or better - Java: 21 (Adoptium) **Optimal (Distant Horizons 256 chunks + high shader settings):** - RAM: 10–12 GB allocated - CPU: Modern 8-core (Ryzen 5 5600X / i7-12700 or better) - GPU: RTX 3070 / RX 6700 XT or better - Java: 21 (Adoptium) > ❗ Do not allocate more than 50% of your system RAM to Minecraft. If you have 16 GB, allocate 8 GB max. --- ## ⚙️ JVM Arguments ``` -Xmx8G -Xms2G -XX:+UseG1GC - XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled - XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 - XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions - XX:+DisableExplicitGC - XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 - XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 - XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M - XX:G1ReservePercent=20 - XX:G1HeapWastePercent=5 - XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 - XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 - XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 - XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 - XX:SurvivorRatio=32 - XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem - XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 ``` *Launcher guide: Prism → Edit Instance > Java | Modrinth App → Instance Settings > Java | CurseForge → Profile Settings > Java | ATLauncher → Settings > Java* --- ## 🌐 Multiplayer Realistify Full is **partially client-side**. | Mod Category | Works client-side only? | |---|---| | All performance mods | ✅ Yes | | All visual mods (Iris, EMF, etc.) | ✅ Yes | | Sound mods | ✅ Yes | | Distant Horizons | ✅ Yes | | Terralith | ❌ Requires server installation | | Serene Seasons | ❌ Requires server installation | | Farmer's Delight (blocks/recipes) | ❌ Requires server installation | | QoL mods | ✅ Yes | The pack works on any vanilla 1.21.1 server. Without matching server mods, you won't see Terralith terrain or seasonal changes — but everything else still works. --- ## 🎯 Perfect For - High-end PC players who want the most immersive Minecraft experience possible - Players who have always wanted Minecraft to sound like a real world - Survival players who want seasonal gameplay and realistic food mechanics - Shader enthusiasts looking for a curated, pre-optimized Fabric base - Anyone who bounced off the Lite edition wanting more depth --- ## 🔧 OptiFine Replacement Notice Realistify Full is **100% OptiFine-free**. | OptiFine Feature | Replacement | |---|---| | Shaders | Iris Shaders | | Connected Textures | Continuity | | Dynamic Lighting | LambDynamicLights | | Custom Entity Models | EMF | | Custom Entity Textures | ETF | | Custom GUI | OptiGUI | | Zoom | Zoomify | | Better Grass | LambdaBetterGrass | | Custom Skies | FabricSkyboxes | --- ## 📦 Version **1.0.0** — Full Edition Initial Release - Complete hyper-realistic mod stack (70 mods) - Sound Physics, AmbientSounds, Presence Footsteps - Terralith terrain + Serene Seasons - Distant Horizons LOD rendering - All configs pre-applied - Optimized for 8 GB+ systems --- ## 📝 Notes - Shaders are **included** - Sound Physics Remastered can be disabled in Mod Menu if CPU-limited - Distant Horizons LOD distance can be adjusted in its settings - **Start new worlds** for Terralith terrain to generate correctly --- NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT.
